questions.question_text: Why do many test takers prefer the PTE Speaking section over other English tests?
options: It is conducted in person with a human examiner.
It is computer-based, which helps reduce test anxiety.
It is done entirely through written essays.
It allows test takers to speak with other candidates.
questions.explanation: Test takers mention that the computer-based format makes them feel more focused and less nervous compared to in-person interviews.

questions.question_text: What is the primary benefit of the computer-based speaking test in PTE?
options: It eliminates potential bias from a human examiner.
It requires candidates to memorize long speeches.
It allows candidates to take the test from home.
It provides unlimited time for each response.
questions.explanation: The test uses AI scoring to ensure objective evaluation, removing prejudice or bias associated with human interaction.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is a key component of the Speaking & Writing section?
options: An oral history presentation.
A group discussion with other students.
Various question types requiring both speaking and writing skills.
A 3-hour long creative writing project.
questions.explanation: Part 1 of the PTE Academic and Core exams consists of multiple question types that specifically assess both speaking and writing abilities.

questions.question_text: What is the primary method of delivery for the PTE test?
options: Face-to-face interview
Computer-based test
Paper-based examination
Group oral presentation
questions.explanation: The PTE exam is delivered entirely via computer in a secure test center.

questions.question_text: Which of these is a benefit of using a computer for the speaking section?
options: You get to talk to a human examiner
It is faster than other methods
It reduces examiner bias
You can use notes during the test
questions.explanation: Computer-based testing eliminates human prejudice during the speaking assessment.

questions.question_text: How many question types are included in the Speaking & Writing section?
questions.explanation: The PTE Academic Speaking & Writing section consists of 9 distinct question types.

questions.question_text: What does the computer-based speaking test help test takers feel?
options: More nervous and unfocused
Less focused and more anxious
More focused and less nervous
More talkative and less prepared
questions.explanation: Test takers often report feeling more relaxed and focused because they are not interacting with a human face-to-face.

questions.question_text: Why do some students prefer the PTE over other English proficiency tests?
options: It requires in-person interviews
It is entirely computer-based
It focuses only on writing skills
It takes over five hours to complete
questions.explanation: The absence of face-to-face interaction is a major reason test takers choose the computer-based PTE format.

questions.question_text: Which device should you use for the speaking part of the test?
options: A standard microphone on a desk
Wired headphones with a microphone
A smartphone app
A wireless Bluetooth headset
questions.explanation: Wired headphones with a microphone are recommended for the best recording quality.

questions.question_text: In the Speaking section, should you worry about neighbors speaking near you?
options: Yes, it will lower your score
Yes, you should ask them to be quiet
No, the microphone will not pick up their voices
No, you should raise your voice to compete
questions.explanation: The test technology is designed to capture only your voice, so noise from neighbors does not impact your score.

questions.question_text: What is the typical time duration for the Speaking & Writing section?
options: 20-30 minutes
30-45 minutes
76-84 minutes
90-120 minutes
questions.explanation: The Speaking and Writing section is the longest part of the test, taking between 76 and 84 minutes.

questions.question_text: Why is the PTE scoring system considered fair?
options: It uses human examiners only
It uses AI scoring and human oversight
It is based on the test taker's home country
It is based on random selection
questions.explanation: PTE combines sophisticated AI with human expertise to ensure scores are objective and free from bias.

questions.question_text: What happens if your account details do not match your passport?
options: You are given extra time
You can correct them on the test day
You will not be allowed to take the test
You get a full refund
questions.explanation: Identity verification is strict; failing to match your booking details with your passport results in being denied entry.
